name: Keynodex Memory
description:
Keynodex Memory is a private, tenant-scoped memory store for Claude and other MCP clients. It stores decisions, preferences, project facts, playbooks, and verified claims so assistants can search, save, and reuse durable context across sessions and tools—not only inside one product’s built-in memory feature.

Sign in with Google and approve access once. Claude can then recall stored work, save durable notes, use artifact-linked recall, and run playbooks for recurring procedures. Each account’s store is isolated from other users.

Connect via remote MCP at memory.keynodex.com. Plan status and upgrades are on the website only; tools never purchase, cancel, or change billing.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Keynodex Memory to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Keynodex Memory to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://memory.keynodex.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Keynodex Memory MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Keynodex Memory lists 24 MCP tools, including agent_debrief, archive_memory, consolidate_memories, context_pack, delete_memory, detect_conflicts, get_account_status, get_context_brief, get_memory, get_session_context, link_memories, and list_memories.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Keynodex Memory?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Keynodex Memory in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does Keynodex Memory MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Keynodex Memory requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Keynodex Memory is developed by Keynodex. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
